parts.text: I keep the drones and charging equipment in working order, which involves adding new drones to the fleet, retiring old ones, setting up charging pads at our sites, taking drones out of service for repairs and putting them back, and sending drones to charge. Regulators can ask us to show how our drones have been looked after, and our repairs and servicing are carried out by technicians. I do not know anything about software or what is needed from the new service.
